normalized_rule: Brihat Jataka assigns sign lords in the Aries-through-Pisces sequence: Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Saturn, and Jupiter.
synthesis_notes: This is a Brihat Jataka/Varahamihira rule, not a universal Jyotisha claim or a scientific statement.
review_notes: Retain the source sequence as one sign-lord taxonomy; do not substitute a later house-lord or dispositority formula.
